verdict.rationale: Guidance for non-resident or foreign founders is a fair question for a state employer-tax agency, so the axis applies. None of the open esd.wa.gov pages in the pack mention non-resident eligibility, acceptable foreign credentials or identifiers, or extra steps for foreign owners. They cover only general employer tasks such as EAMS setup, quarterly reports, tax rates, appeals and penalty waivers. The authenticated portal was not crawled, so there is no further evidence.
